title: Hello Kitty Ambient RGB LED Table Lamp, Dual Color - New
categoryName: Collectibles:Animation Art & Merchandise:Animation Merchandise:Other Animation Merchandise
descriptionText: This ambient table lamp is perfect for any Hello Kitty fan. With its RGB LED light and dual color function, it adds a touch of fun and whimsy to any room. The lamp is made of durable plastic and features the iconic Hello Kitty character. It was manufactured in China in 2002 and is part of the Hello Kitty Sanrio franchise. The lamp is multicolored and has a animated theme, making it a great addition to any collection.
